description: This file defines an Android activity class ContentInfoActivity that displays full-screen content information, including title, synopsis, and action buttons, using native views to emulate a pixel-perfect layout suitable for TV screens. The class manages focus behavior, layout constraints, and user interactions for navigation via remote control.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for displaying content information in a TV-optimized, pixel-perfect layout, handling focus navigation and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout, extracts intent extras, builds UI components such as titles, synopsis, action buttons, and sets up focus behavior.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles hardware key events such as the back button to finish the activity.

methods.name: pillButtonView
methods.description: Creates a focusable, clickable button with custom background colors for focused and unfocused states, supporting arrow key navigation.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Creates a non-focusable view used as spacing between UI elements.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density for layout sizing.
